name: extract-pos
description:
Words of one part of speech (a participle is none of them).

kind: "noun", "adj", "verb" or "adverb".

A word is looked up as written, with its punctuation («диван,» is not a noun). An adjective is a word coded «a», or a word with no code, a pronoun or a particle whose lemma ends like an adjective («какой»); a word with a capital is looked up in lower case («Быстро» is an adverb, not an adjective).

Example: semkit read --text "купить красный диван" extract-pos noun write -
-> диван

extract-pos keeps only what the matcher finds in the working column; an empty cell where it finds nothing.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
